assets.name: knowledge-tab-gray-v2
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: attached five-tab screenshot. Extract the TOP gray tab originally labelled LIST. The four gray tabs share the same artwork after text removal; export ONLY ONE representative gray tab, using the top tab. Remove its LIST text. Preserve its original gray-green dark fill, subtle top-left reflection, thin silver outlines, beveled clipped corners, horizontal proportions and faint shadows. No lime highlight, no new glow. Output ONE isolated text-free button with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside its silhouette and soft shadow/glow. Keep the button interior opaque as in original. No white fill, no black matte, no checkerboard image, no labels, no other tabs or objects. Do not redesign, brighten, stretch, simplify or add icons. Retain original geometry, colors and fine border details as closely as possible. Tightly frame with a small transparent margin without clipping any edge or shadow.
